annotation.bound_parties_text: The regulation binds economic operators (manufacturer, authorised representative, importer, distributor) of UAS, third-country UAS operators, and conformity assessment/approved bodies and market surveillance authorities.
annotation.bound_parties_quote: 'economic operators' means the manufacturer, the authorised representative of the manufacturer, the importer, and the distributor of the UAS;
annotation.dates_quote: Word in Annex Pt. 16 substituted (1.1.2026) by The Unmanned Aircraft (Amendment) Regulations 2025 (S.I. 2025/1106)
annotation.robot_provision_quote: Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2019/945 of 12 March 2019 on unmanned aircraft systems and on third-country operators of unmanned aircraft systems
